picks.name: Spiritual Overflow
picks.annotation: Keeps getting buffs for some reason, just become a massive stat stick and you love all of them. Getting built out of Lifesteal is crazy nice.

picks.name: Crippling Headshot
picks.annotation: A ton of shred AND anti-heal but relies on headshots. Great as a gun investment filler late game. Check replacements for more info.

picks.name: Fleetfoot
picks.annotation: Used to be the goat but other 1.6k items just feel more impactful.

picks.name: Toxic Bullets
picks.annotation: Crazy item that scales with enemy hp, all spirit, any shred/amp (3 and EE), helps scale EE, reduces healing, and good for finishing. Gun spike now.

picks.name: Indomitable
picks.annotation: Very similar use case to Unstop, but mainly if one guy is jumping you instead of mass CC.

picks.name: Enchanter's Emblem
picks.annotation: Early bump in survivability and damage. Rarely can switch for Healbane to get it earlier.

picks.name: Trophy Collector
picks.annotation: TROPHY COLLECTOR. Now a crazy item since other nerfs. Buy when you're going crazy and carrying to keep the lead.

picks.name: Unstoppable
picks.annotation: Amazing if you are getting CC'ed a ton. Hard requirement if you want to ult a lot.

picks.name: Spirit Burn
picks.annotation: Highest anti-heal in the game, but hard for you to activate. Expensive and unreliable but sometimes they do be healing.

picks.name: Greater Expansion
picks.annotation: This is okay for ult and stun, ball too of course. If you have Ballistic Enchantment on ball you don't really need this until end game as a luxury replacement.

picks.name: Boundless Spirit
picks.annotation: A huge global upgrade to your whole kit. Ton of spirit power and even more Regen.

picks.name: Lightning Scroll
picks.annotation: Technically high impact but the stun duration isn't that long and I'm not a huge fan of sitting in Ult for long. Just try echo shard instead if you want CC.

picks.annotation: Mainly just inferior to Duration, requires a bigger buy in to effect items and a ton of items you buy scale with duration anyway.
